messages:
lina: Quick one — spotted a mismatch between the Console Help inlay and main docs: Console UI labels the area as 'Endpoints' but the in-product docs page and API reference use 'route' in headings. Users hit the help panel and see two different words back-to-back.

sam: Oof, that could cause confusion. Which term should be canonical for public surfaces? @anne @ravi any historical context?

anne: Historically the API design doc used 'route' internally, but the Console copy was carried forward from the legacy control plane where engineers used 'endpoint'. We never reconciled.

ravi: Docs perspective: we standardized on 'route' in the reference because it maps to the YAML field name. But search/logs show a lot of people type 'endpoint' when looking for setup docs.

lina: Accessibility snag: screen-reader label for the help widget reads 'Endpoints help' but the linked doc's H1 reads 'Routes', so SR users hear different semantics. We should not swap terms without fixing aria labels.

docs-bot: search-metrics: "endpoint" queries = 52% , "route" = 48% over last 6 months. Both are common.

sam: Options: (A) pick one global term and change everywhere, (B) keep Console as-is but add immediate inlay clarification (e.g., small "Terminology" micro-link), (C) alias both in docs and add redirect. Thoughts?

ravi: I'm leaning to (B)+(C): keep front-end label as 'Endpoints' (familiar to users), add microcopy in the Help panel linking to glossary "Endpoints (aka routes)", update docs to include an H1 anchor /docs/endpoints that explains aliasing, and add short redirects from /docs/routes -> /docs/endpoints. That minimizes churn but gives clarity.

anne: Sounds pragmatic. From product POV, we should log the decision in the style guide so future copy follows 'Endpoints' on Console surfaces. Docs can keep the API-level 'route' term where needed but must show aliasing at the top.

lina: UX: I will prototype a compact header for the Help inlay: "Endpoints — Terminology" with a tiny underlined link that opens the glossary modal/anchor. Avoid parenthetical text in the header to prevent awkward wrapping on small widths. I'll also update aria-labels to read e.g. "Endpoints help, opens glossary" so SR users get the alias context.

devex: Implementation notes: I'll add a search synonym mapping (routes -> endpoints) in our site search, a lightweight redirect for /docs/routes, and a brief console config change for aria-label. Planning to ship as a deploy with feature flag so we can rollback quickly if anything strange shows up in analytics.

sam: Can we also update cross-link behavior so existing in-product "Learn more" links always go to the canonical /docs/endpoints anchor? That avoids 302 chains.

ravi: Yep. I'll add the canonical anchor and a short blurb: "We use 'Endpoints' in the Console; in references you may see 'Routes' which refers to the same concept." I'll keep the API examples showing YAML field names ('route: /v1/foo') but annotate them.

anne: Add an owner and timeline: docs (ravi) to draft alias content and redirect by EOB Wednesday. Design (lina) to drop Figma frame for the inlay micro-link by EOD today. Eng (devex) to add search synonym + redirect and ARIA update in next sprint.

lina: I'll also run a quick SR test on narrow widths and attach the frame here.

devex: I'll make a small migration checklist and ping on the PR. Also will log a short analytics event so we can measure clicks on the glossary link vs direct doc visits.

sam: TL;DR: keep Console label 'Endpoints', alias 'route' in docs and glossary, add micro-link in Help panel, fix aria-labels, add redirects and search synonym. Owners: docs=ravi, design=lina, eng=devex. :+1:

lina: Thanks all — will post the mock shortly and tag for review.
